row.title: A second-loop step is judged by every essential variable, not only its own
row.body: The kernel reviewed a knob change against the goal it was made for and kept it when that goal moved, whatever it did to the others. Ashby's journal (J.5307, J.5360) gives every part a veto and shows that correcting many reactions without one settles at a fixed share correct. goals.js undoes such a step and reads the undo as a trial. Evidence: node --test seed/worker/test/ashby-loop.test.js in the session, 6 tests pass; not yet deployed, so no live reading exists.
